summary: #126 (after #498): the plugin no longer makes the Gateway copy OpenClaw into its plugin capture. Host SDK modules are imported by bare openclaw/plugin-sdk/... specifier when the module itself resolves the same file (Gateway capture link to the live host), the model profile contract is read from its hashed chunk as text instead of imported, and the extension directory holds the runtime set only (dist and the two manifests).
reason: S24 01/11 18:25 (e0093963, #498 deployed): the first owner turn still spent 72.4 s under plugin-generation-artifact. The process capture directory showed 21 045 host files (openclaw dist 1 057 files and 192 whole packages, 190 MB) copied because loadInstalledSessionStoreSdk imported the session store surface and the contract chunk by file URL: 41.9 s of the profile (36.8 s before #498). The plugin directory itself (983 files, 826 of them fixtures, scripts and sources) was copied twice (about 4 s). The capture is a per-process snapshot removed at exit, never a reusable cache.

architecture.reason: Existing loaders and installer only; OpenClaw's own host link and native resolution are used. No new store, router, scheduler, daemon or retry.

evidence: Plugin module loading and extension file set only; no MCP tool, schema or adapter change.

limitations: Expected gain from the 18:25 profile: about 45 s of the 72.4 s under capture (session store surface 41.9 s, plugin directory about 4 s down to about 0.6 s); to be measured on the S24 after deployment with the same restart profile.
About 22 s remain for the three @openclaw/whatsapp captures (3 x 3 360 files), owned by OpenClaw, outside this plugin.
The first deployment removes the old sources, scripts and fixtures from the extension; runtime-sync reports a remaining full copy as gateway_plugin drift.
